links.outcome: Alignment of ChatGPT responses with expert consensus mean scores on ankyloglossia statements
links.effect: 67% of ChatGPT responses closely aligned with expert consensus; 17% (11/63) differed from the consensus mean by 2.0 or greater.
links.quote: However, 17 % (11/63) were statements in which the ChatGPT mean response was different from the CCS mean by 2.0 or greater, raising concerns about ChatGPT's potential influence in disseminating uncertain or debated medical information.

screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study testing the baseline factual accuracy and alignment of ChatGPT against consensus guidelines on ankyloglossia without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards or practices.
